# Rajdhani

Rajdhani is used by the ProjectHunter item tooltip UI.

- Source: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Rajdhani
- Upstream files: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/rajdhani
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see `OFL.txt`)

Imported Unreal assets are stored in:

`/Game/ProjectHunter/UI/Fonts/Rajdhani`

Tooltip usage:

- Item name: SemiBold, 24
- Item type: Regular, 17
- Section heading: SemiBold, 17
- Row label and centered description: Regular, 15
- Row value: SemiBold, 15
